name: Christ The King
overview: Scripture reveals Christ as the King of glory, a mighty and victorious Lord who enters through everlasting gates, as proclaimed in Psalms 24:7-10. He is depicted as exalted above all, fairer than men and eternally blessed by God, demonstrating His glorious and righteous reign (Psalms 45:1-2). This King’s kingdom is everlasting and universal, affirming His sovereign rule over all creation.
